description.rationale: Description is metadata only and does not affect any security controls.

disabled.description: Whether this exclusion rule should be disabled or not. This defaults to false.
disabled.rationale: When disabled = false (default), the exclusion actively filters logs. Disabled exclusions (true) do not filter logs, which may indicate misconfiguration or incomplete security controls. Exclusions should be either active or removed entirely.

filter.description: The filter to apply when excluding logs. Only log entries that match the filter are excluded.
filter.rationale: The filter determines which logs are excluded. Excluding security-relevant logs (audit logs, high severity logs, IAM changes) creates critical security blind spots and violates CIS GCP Benchmark requirements. Filters should be restricted to non-security logs only.

name.description: The name of the logging exclusion.
name.rationale: Name is a unique identifier for the exclusion filter. It has no security implications beyond being a reference name.

project.description: The project to create the exclusion in. If omitted, the project associated with the provider is used.
project.rationale: This identifies which project owns the exclusion filter. It has no direct security impact on the exclusion's behavior.
